Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for the time earlier — really appreciated the deep dive into Acme's roadmap and success criteria. Quick recap and next steps from our side, plus the initial MAP draft attached (MAP_v1.xlsx):

Summary of discovery
- Primary use: customer support triage + internal summaries (long-term plan to expand to product insights).
- Success criteria: 90th percentile latency < 300ms for 1k qps test, < 2% semantic drift on our baseline eval prompts, and integration with SSO + audit logs.
- Key stakeholders: Sarah King (Head of Data & AI), Tom Liu (Engineering Manager), Procurement (review SOW/PO).

Proposed MAP highlights (see attached sheet for full milestones):
1) Kickoff & scoping (Redwood / Acme) — target completion 2026-03-31 — owner: Redwood (Marissa / Camila).
2) Security & compliance review (share SOC2, network diagram) — target completion 2026-04-07 — owner: Acme (Security) + Redwood (Rishi).
3) SOW & procurement (legal review + PO) — target completion 2026-04-28 — owner: Acme Procurement.
4) Staging integration & runbook validation — target completion 2026-05-08 — owner: Acme Eng + Redwood SEs.
5) Go-live (production) — target: 2026-05-15 — owner: Acme Eng / Redwood Ops.

Dependencies: procurement PO, SOC2 evidence (we can provide), timely access for staging environment.

Next steps / asks:
- Please review MAP_v1.xlsx and confirm any edits to milestones, owners, or the target go-live.
- Flag any additional success criteria we missed.
- If this looks good, we'll pull SOW into a DocuSign envelope and loop legal.

Attached: MAP_v1.xlsx

Best,
